forWhat: The first page you see. It shows your day and the kinds of work waiting on you, in the order the week runs.
Each kind of work is one row with its count and one button. Choose a row to see its jobs on the right. Each job has its own button.

layout.shows: For an educator, the button opens your next lesson. For the coordinator, [[Open the first:]] takes you to the first job waiting.
A few numbers that matter today, such as notes to confirm and papers to check. Each opens what it counts.
For an educator, today's lessons in order. Choose one to see it on the right.
A filter row (Subject, Class and What), how many jobs wait on you, and one row for each kind of work, such as [[Topics to mark as taught]], [[Answers to check]] and [[Parent reports to approve]].
A row you choose opens here with its jobs, each with its own button. Close it with the cross or Escape.
A folded note of what the school's answers say this week.

jobs.title: Start your day
steps: Choose a row under Waiting on you to see its jobs on the right, or press the row's own button.
Press the button beside a job to do that one job. The row's count goes down as you work.

jobs.title: Say a topic was taught
steps: Choose the row [[Topics to mark as taught]].
Press [[Mark as taught]] beside the topic. If it is taught in more than one of your classes, choose the class first.
The topic is now taught for that class alone. Its skills can go on that class's papers.

buttons.label: Open the first:
buttons.does: Opens the first job waiting on you.
buttons.doesNot: It does not do the job for you.

buttons.label: Mark as taught
buttons.does: Records the topic as taught for that one class, in your name.
